desc:
🏠 Stay the Night

Cozy by day. Hunted by night.

🛒 Grab furniture from the supermarket and haul it home
✨ Make your house cozier to unlock rarer survivors
💰 Survivors move in and pay you rent
🏡 Buy bigger houses, a fence, a playground, a car port
🌙 At night the Beast prowls the streets... anyone outside gets eaten
🚪 Get home before dark!
